summary: Build 208 connects the value-added modules into one owner-facing lifecycle: lead/quote → booking → proof of work → invoice/payment → review → repeat maintenance.
north_star: Every customer should have a clear next step, every staff/admin action should lead toward revenue, proof, payment, review, or repeat maintenance.

workflow_stages.label: Lead / quote
workflow_stages.owner_goal: Turn every inquiry into a trackable quote with dollar value, source, age, follow-up stage, and likely revenue.
workflow_stages.next_build_push: Add quote create/edit/save from lead rows and deposit request actions directly on /admin-quotes.html.

workflow_stages.label: Booking
workflow_stages.owner_goal: Move accepted quotes into confirmed bookings with service area, business-hours, holiday, add-on, and deposit checks.
workflow_stages.next_build_push: Add one-click Convert Accepted Quote to Booking from the quote pipeline.

workflow_stages.label: Proof of work
workflow_stages.owner_goal: Give detailers a mobile job workspace with start photos, finish photos, condition notes, tasks, incident quick-create, and customer-safe proof.
workflow_stages.next_build_push: Add mobile proof-of-work checklist controls to /detailer-jobs.html with required photo gates.

workflow_stages.label: Invoice / payment
workflow_stages.owner_goal: Close the money loop with invoices, deposits, balances, webhook status, receipts, refunds, and HST/GST review.
workflow_stages.next_build_push: Add one owner card showing balances due today, missing receipts, and tax review warnings.

workflow_stages.label: Review / public proof
workflow_stages.owner_goal: Request reviews after completed work, then turn approved reviews and before/after images into local proof blocks.
attention_rules: approved review not reused as proof
public gallery item has broken image
workflow_stages.next_build_push: Add review request queue actions and approval-to-proof buttons.

workflow_stages.label: Repeat maintenance
workflow_stages.owner_goal: Bring good customers back through vehicle history, seasonal reminders, maintenance plans, and route clustering.
attention_rules: completed customer has no next service suggestion
workflow_stages.next_build_push: Create reminders from completed bookings and show them in customer vehicle history.
